Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From "Hrvoje Pastar" <hpa...@inet.hr> =====

>Can I play Body arsenal and for strike Scorpion Sting?
>And if is damage 2 Aggr + 1 normal, please answer.

Yes. The damage done is strength+1 damage, all of which
is aggravated (and based on your increased strength from
the Body Arsenal) If your base strength is 1, then Body
Arsenal at superior would set that to 2 and Scorpion
Sting would inflict 3 (2+1) damage, all of which would be
aggravated, since it's all from the hand strike and
therefore all hand damage.

>And can leather jacket prevent Coma , oposing minion goes to torpor card?

No. Damage prevention effects can prevent only damage.
